scope: focused combined regression selection, not full workspace or final candidate

command:
set -euo pipefail
 unset PYTHONPATH
 export PATH="$HOME/scratch/rumoca/workshop427-exports/cache/venv/bin:$PATH"
 export PYO3_PYTHON="$HOME/scratch/rumoca/workshop427-exports/cache/venv/bin/python"
 export CARGO_HOME="$HOME/.cargo" CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$HOME/scratch/rumoca/workshop427-ci/target"
 export TMPDIR="$HOME/scratch/rumoca/browser-tmp"
 export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4
 export CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
 exec cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude rumoca-bind-python --exclude rumoca-bind-wasm --features rumoca/msl-sim-tests --no-fail-fast --test-threads 4 -E "package(rumoca-ir-dae) | package(rumoca-phase-structural) | test(algebraic_family_compaction) | test(structured_selected_indices) | test(empty_reduction_tests) | test(a_triangular_constructor_domain_is_rejected_at_its_index) | test(runtime_index_derivative) | test(dynamic_active_return_predicates_keep_invalid_gather_faults) | test(late_source_fault_keeps_prior_tuple_commits_then_recovers_without_input_mutation) | test(registry_invariants) | test(an_event_guarded_conditional_differentiates_its_selected_branch) | test(tensor_parameter_branches_preserve_values_and_shaped_zero_derivatives) | test(piecewise_state_definition_is_differentiated_per_branch)"
